			mdcw_nsb_anti_air_1950 = 1

mdcw_apply_1970_infantry_research = {
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1969.12.31 date < 1970.1.2 NOT = { has_country_flag = mdcw_1970_infantry_research_applied } }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = ABK } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_ABK = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = ACE } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_ACE = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = ADJ } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_ADJ = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = ADO } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_ADO = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = ADY } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_ADY = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = AFG } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_AFG = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = AFR } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_AFR = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = AGL } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_AGL = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = ALA } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_ALA = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = ALB } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_ALB = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = ALG } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_ALG = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = ALT } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_ALT = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = ANT } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_ANT = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = AQY } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_AQY = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = ARA } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_ARA = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = ARG } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_ARG = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = ARK } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_ARK = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = ARM } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_ARM = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = ASK } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_ASK = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = AST } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_AST = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = AUS } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_AUS = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = AZE } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_AZE = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = BAH } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_BAH = yes }

		if = { limit = { original_tag = BAN } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_BAN = yes }

		if = { limit = { original_tag = BAY } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_BAY = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = BDA } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_BDA = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = BEL } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_BEL = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = BEN } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_BEN = yes }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = BFA } mdcw_1970_infantry_profile_BFA = yes }
